messages:
olivia: quick ping — PR #14789 updates eviction+fallback routing logic. Needs runtime + infra + security eyes before canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/14789. TL;DR: prefer local KV cache on fallback, add 50ms jitter to eviction to reduce thundering-herd, add telemetry tags `evict_reason` and `fallback_source`

ci-bot: CI: unit tests ✅, integration tests ✅, canary image build queued (sha: a1b2c3d)

kevin: @olivia thanks — can you paste the eviction delay config? curious where the 50ms comes from

olivia: sure — current config snippet:```yaml
eviction:
  base_delay_ms: 20
  jitter_ms: 50
  strategy: soft_delay
```
We picked 50ms after the load bench where bursts at 0-100rps caused ~30% concurrent re-evicts. 50ms drops that to <5%

maria: can you attach the bench numbers? I want to make sure it doesn't push too much tail latency on the dedupe path

olivia: pasted results (summary): local KV hit rate up from 72% -> 94% under burst test, p99 latency for serve path +2ms, eviction-related retries down 87%. Full CSV uploaded to the PR artifacts

alex: quick security note — adding `fallback_source` telemetry is fine but avoid logging actual keys or identifiers. Ensure it's just enum values like `local`, `remote`, `stale`

olivia: yep we only send enums and feature flags. not logging keys. updated PR with that change (commit b7f4e2c)

kevin: code looks small. one nit: the fallback selector function still does an async list copy, could we avoid extra alloc in the common path?```diff
-  const candidates = await listCandidates()
+  const candidates = await listCandidatesLazy() // yields iterator
```

olivia: good catch — swapped to iterator in b7f4e2c. Bench before/after shows negligible perf diff but reduces allocations on hot path

maria: infra: I ran a quick canary in staging image `canary-evict-a1b2c3d`, load 200rps for 10m. No OOMs, node CPU stable. I'm 👍 pending security sign-off

alex: I reviewed and request one tiny log change: `logger.debug('fallback=%s', fallback_source)` -> `logger.debug('fallback=%s', fallback_source || 'unknown')` so we don't get `null` entries in aggregated logs. If you push that I'll stamp

olivia: pushed log guard in c9d4f11. updated PR description with staging run link and perf CSV

kevin: LGTM from runtime side :+1: pending infra canary — looks good

maria: infra-approve :white_check_mark: once sec ok, can schedule merge window. Prefer 09:00 PST low-traffic tomorrow

alex: security-approve :shield: assuming we only surface enums. Approve from me

ci-bot: Merge checks: branch clean, no conflicts, passed gates. Merge blocked until at least one human approves the PR in GitHub (approvals present)

olivia: thanks all. scheduling canary merge at 09:00 PST tomorrow. tagging on-call for canary monitor. I'll follow up if any rollback required

kevin: works for me

maria: I'll be available for monitoring 08:50-10:30 PST

alex: I'll glance at logs around canary start, ping if I see anything suspicious

olivia: awesome — merging at schedule unless someone objects
